purpose: Resizable list-and-detail layout with a list header, keyboard selection, the open item kept in the URL, a remembered divider width, and a one-pane-at-a-time layout on narrow containers.
useWhen: Browsing a collection of records where choosing one shows it beside the list, such as chats, runs, or memories.
The open record must survive a reload and be shareable as a link.

avoidWhen.reason: Each record has its own page and the list is only a way to navigate there.
You need the resizable layout alone, with no list.

a11y.pattern: Region landmarks with a native button or link row action

keyboard.action: Moves the keyboard cursor to the next row.
Moves the keyboard cursor to the previous row.
Opens the row the cursor is on.

notes: J and K are ignored while focus is in a text field, a menu, a listbox, a combobox or a dialog, so typing is never taken.
